summary: Iteration 3 tested the HireMyFace admin panel end to end, both backend and frontend. I found and fixed one CRITICAL bug: admin_dep was require_role('admin'), so the OWNER (main admin) got 403 on every /api/admin/* endpoint except /admin/team. I changed it to require_role('owner','admin') in server.py. BACKEND: 19 tests in the new tests/test_admin_panel.py; 18 pass and 1 fails, which is a real bug (admin can post chat messages that show the creator's name). What passed: access control (no token 401, member 403, helper 200, team endpoints 403 for helper and 200 for owner); owner adding a helper (existing user becomes admin, unknown email becomes an invite, duplicate 400, remove, 404); stats for all 4 ranges plus attention and money_mode; approvals (reject without reason 400, reject with reason stores review_note and notifies, approve shows in /creators); reports on all 4 target types (duplicate 409, self-report 400, 404, 422, 401), and the deal report detail includes messages; resolving with warn, dismiss and remove (deal remove 400, dispute actions on a report 400, re-resolving 404); payout failed with no UPI, admin retry 400 then 200 once a UPI exists; PATCH /me payout_upi auto-releases; direct release when the creator has a UPI; dispute release ends completed/released, refund ends refunded and paid_by_businesses drops; helpers can't block self, admin or owner; blocking a creator gives 403 account_blocked, hides them from /creators, pauses the deal and rejects deal actions and messages, and unblocking restores all of it; blocking a business hides its jobs, profile and saved entry and refuses interest; job and post removal (wrong prefix 409); activity log; concurrent mark_delivered (no 500, a single payout). I also updated the iteration 1 and 2 regression suites for the removed endpoints and renamed stats keys; all 47 pass. FRONTEND (Playwright, Clerk tickets): the helper's shield goes to /admin; the desktop side menu and the mobile bottom tabs at 390px both work, and Team is hidden for the helper (a direct /admin/team visit goes to /admin); dashboard range switch, attention cards, MOCKED banner; reject dialog needs 3 or more characters; users search, role filter and detail; block dialog, then the creator sees the blocked screen and is signed out to '/' after about 6s, then unblock; jobs and posts removal; deals filters; reports list, kind filter, side sheet (note, deal chat, release/refund for disputes, 4 actions for reports) and resolving; activity log; the owner sees Team (invite and cancel). Report buttons work on the creator profile, business profile, Discover job card and deal chat (duplicate shows a toast), and none shows on your own profile. 'Raise a dispute' in DealRoom works. A non-admin visiting /admin is redirected to /app.

critical.issue: FIXED BY TESTER. admin_dep = require_role('admin') excluded the 'owner' role, so the main admin (OWNER_EMAIL) got 403 'Not allowed' on the dashboard, approvals, users, reports and the rest. I changed it to require_role('owner','admin'). Verified: owner gets 200 on /admin/stats and the owner dashboard and team UI load.

minor.issue: get_deal_for gives admins access to every deal, and send_message sets sender_name = creator_name when the sender isn't the business. So an admin (for example via the Deals link in UserDetail to /app/chat/{id}) can post into any chat AS THE CREATOR, and the business is notified 'New message from <creator>'. Confirmed: 200 with sender_name='TEST Admin Creator'. Fix: reject non-parties (403), or label admin messages as 'HireMyFace team'.

PAID_STATES = paid/delivered/completed. After a dispute (status 'disputed') or a 'refunded' result, contact details are masked again and DealRoom shows 'Phone numbers... hidden until the deal is paid' even though it was paid. Add 'disputed' (and probably 'refunded') to the unmask states, or keep a paid_at check.

Not atomic. It reads the status, then calls update_one without a status guard. Concurrent mark_delivered calls passed (one payout, thanks to the unique index), but dispute and mark_delivered racing could leave the deal disputed with the payout released. Use find_one_and_update with {status:'paid'} in the filter.
Counts approved, non-sample creators but includes blocked or offline ones. 'Live creators' can be misleading.
Disputed deals are also paused when the creator is blocked. That's fine, but admin_resolve doesn't clear paused, so a released or refunded deal keeps paused=true until unblock. Cosmetic only.

ui_bugs.issue: Inviting an unknown email (result='invited') toasts 'Admin added', and cancelling a pending invite toasts 'Admin removed'. Use 'Invite sent' and 'Invite cancelled'.

issues: 7 tabs scroll horizontally, so Dashboard and Approvals scroll off-screen once you're on Deals or Activity. Acceptable, but consider a 'More' tab.
The Seg has min-w-[520px], so the 'All' option is cut off at the left edge when scrolled.
Shows the 'Approved' pill for a blocked creator. Consider also showing 'Hidden/blocked'.

action_items: Keep the admin_dep fix (require_role('owner','admin')) and add a regression check that the owner can reach /api/admin/stats.
Block non-party (admin) messages in POST /deals/{id}/messages, or label them as the team. Right now admins can impersonate the creator.
Treat 'disputed' (and 'refunded') as paid for contact unmasking in list_messages and send_message, and update the DealRoom masking banner.
Make mark_delivered and dispute atomic with a status guard (find_one_and_update on status 'paid').
Fix the Team toasts for invites, debounce the users search, and tidy the mobile admin tabs and deals filter overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1398 lines (more than 700). Split it into routers: profiles/jobs, deals/payments, admin, reports.
require_role does exact matching. Use RANK (already defined) so higher roles inherit lower-role permissions, which prevents another owner-lockout bug like this one.

The blocked check in current_member is correct, and Clerk session revoke runs too. MeContext polls /me every 30s, so a user blocked mid-session gets the blocked screen (or is signed out by Clerk) within about 30s.

file_report relies on the unique index (reporter, target_type, target_id, kind) for 409. After a dispute is resolved, the same business can't dispute again (that's fine because the deal is terminal), but a DuplicateKeyError in deal_action's dispute insert isn't caught (it would be a 500 if it ever happened).
Startup demotes any 'owner' whose email isn't OWNER_EMAIL. That's good, but OWNER_EMAIL's user doesn't exist in preview yet, so nobody in preview is the owner. Testers have to set role manually.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_hiremyface_api.py (updated for removed /admin/deals/{id}/release, /admin/payments, /users and the new stats keys)

success_rate.backend: 95% (18/19 new; 47/47 regression; the 1 failure is the admin-impersonation bug)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows passed (minor copy/UX issues)

test_credentials: Used the admin, brand and creator +clerk_test users from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. The admin role was temporarily set to 'owner' and restored to 'admin'. All users are unblocked, with role member/member/admin.
seed_data_creation: Everything was deleted at the end with `python tests/test_admin_panel.py` (cleanup only): deals, messages, payments, payouts, reports, jobs, interests, notifications, admin_log entries by the test admin, test_ admin_invites, and the creator/business profiles of the test users. The users were reset (role, pro_until=None, payout_upi='', active_mode=None, unblocked). The owner email user was never touched (it doesn't exist in preview).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_admin_panel.py -n 0 (it cleans up before and after; set KEEP_ADMIN_TEST_DATA=1 to keep data for UI runs, then run `python tests/test_admin_panel.py` to clean). Regression: tests/test_hiremyface_api.py then tests/test_iter2_features.py, run serially. Blocking a user revokes their Clerk sessions, so mint fresh tokens or tickets afterwards (tok(who, fresh=True)). Seg testids: admin-range-today|7d|30d|all, reports-kind-dispute, reports-status-resolved, content-tab-posts, deals-filter-failed, discover-tabs-businesses. ReasonDialog testids: <testid>-input/-confirm (reject-dialog, block-dialog, remove-dialog, resolve-dialog). The Reports side sheet animates in, so wait about 1s before taking a screenshot.
rca of the issue: Owner lockout: admin_dep = require_role('admin') and require_role does `member['role'] not in roles`. The owner's role is 'owner', so it was rejected on every admin_dep route. Repro: set users.role='owner' for the test admin, then GET /api/admin/stats returned 403. Fix: require_role('owner','admin'). Admin impersonation: get_deal_for skips scoping for ADMIN_ROLES, and send_message picks sender_name with `deal['business_name'] if is_b else deal['creator_name']`.
